Título: Effects of Funneliformis mosseae inoculation on yield compnents of field-grown maize
Resumen: We evaluated the effect of inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi on maize under field conditions. Inoculated plots were compared with non-inoculated controls in a randomized complete block design with four replicates. Grain yield increased by 17% on average, and the response was larger where available soil phosphorus was low.
